hudson.tasks.Shell.command: #!/bin/sh set -eu IMAGE="react-midterm-ci:${BUILD_NUMBER}" TEMP_CONTAINER="react-ci-extract-${BUILD_NUMBER}" # Remove output left by earlier builds. rm -rf artifacts extracted mkdir -p artifacts extracted/site cleanup() { docker rm -f "$TEMP_CONTAINER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true } trap cleanup EXIT # Install dependencies, test, and build using Dockerfile. docker build --progress=plain -t "$IMAGE" . # Extract the compiled application from the final image. docker create --name "$TEMP_CONTAINER" "$IMAGE" docker cp "$TEMP_CONTAINER:/usr/share/nginx/html/." extracted/site/ # Record the source CI build and Git commit. cat > extracted/site/release.json <<EOF { "ci_build": "${BUILD_NUMBER}", "git_commit": "${GIT_COMMIT}" } EOF # Include the Dockerfile used to serve the artifact. cp Dockerfile.deploy extracted/Dockerfile # Package the compiled files and serving Dockerfile. tar -czf "artifacts/react-app-${BUILD_NUMBER}.tar.gz" \ -C extracted site Dockerfile echo "Created artifact: react-app-${BUILD_NUMBER}.tar.gz" echo "Source commit: ${GIT_COMMIT}"
